meaning: 每天大概都能看到游客
usageNote: probably是'大概/应该'的意思，表示你有把握但不是100%确定，比maybe更自信一点点！

examples.en: Working at the Eiffel Tower, you probably see tourists every day.
examples.zh: 在埃菲尔铁塔工作，你大概每天都能看到游客。

examples.en: Living near Times Square, they probably see tourists every day without even trying.
examples.zh: 住在时代广场附近，他们大概每天不用刻意就能看到游客。
